headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 10-2 victory. Colton Cowser led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. The Boston Red Sox suffered a tough defeat on the road, losing 8-3 to the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Connor Wong leading the Red Sox offense with a strong performance, going 2-for-3 with a home run and 3 RBIs. The Atlanta Braves secured a 5-3 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Didier Fuentes earning the win and Raisel Iglesias securing the save.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their availability for the remainder of the season. Athletics right-handed pitcher Justin Sterner has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis. The Los Angeles Dodgers placed LHP Justin Wrobleski on the 15-day injured list due to left forearm inflammation. The Boston Red Sox have placed DH Masataka Yoshida on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain and RHP Justin Slaten on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 13, 2026, with right elbow inflammation.

The Milwaukee Brewers have bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, who was traded to the team from the Athletics for cash. The Athletics have also traded shortstop Jonathan Ornelas to the Brewers for cash. The Boston Red Sox traded center fielder Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles as part of the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade.
